title: Who is in the room, live, in the lobby and the mini view

tasks.title: Room sessions with holds, fresh tokens per connection, and the presence list

acs.text: WHEN a member has a room's lobby open THE SYSTEM SHALL connect to `<relayOrigin>/r/<roomId>` offering `sefaria-social.v1` and `bearer.<a fresh identity token>` as subprotocols, and list every participant by name, marking who leads (the spotlight), whom each follows, and who is away, updating as the room changes.
scenarios: The lobby lists who is here

acs.text: WHEN the viewer appears in the list THE SYSTEM SHALL mark their entry as "you" and offer no way to follow themselves; every name is rendered with `dir="auto"` so Hebrew names read correctly.
scenarios: The viewer is marked and cannot follow themselves

acs.text: WHEN the connection drops THE SYSTEM SHALL say the room is reconnecting and keep the last list until the room answers again; WHEN nothing needs the room any more (the lobby closed, no context, no live session) THE SYSTEM SHALL close the connection.
scenarios: Reconnecting keeps the list; leaving closes the socket
